messages:
alisha: Quick FYI — final loop for Arman R. (Senior ML Infra) is scheduled for Thu 4/11. Need a day-of coordinator to cover check-in, badge handoff, quiet room monitoring, and post-loop feedback capture. Also confirming travel stipend, hotel pickup, interpreter (Spanish requested), and a loaner laptop if needed.

sam: Candidate ETA 08:30, prefers coffee on arrival. Panel schedule currently 09:00–12:00 (onsite) with a remote interviewer joining 14:00–16:00. Arman mentioned a dairy-free allergy.

mike: I'm onsite for the morning interviews and can stay for lunch. Priya had to move to remote for the afternoon slot. I'll take the 09:00 loop.

ben: @alisha @sam I can reserve Quiet Room Q3 for the whole morning and get a parking pass added. Can also do a hotel pickup voucher (Lyft) — need candidate phone and hotel name.

kelly: I'll prepare a loaner laptop + temp build VM. Need candidate email for provisioning. ETA for pickup window?

alisha: Thanks — Sam can you drop the candidate email + hotel name here? Also please confirm whether interpreter is required in-person or remote. If in-person, Office Ops needs 48h notice.

sam: Email: arman.rey@example.com. Hotel: The Meridian — arrival 4/10 night. Interpreter: remote preferred but candidate said they "might" use it; I'll confirm today.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Arman R. — Final Loop" Thu Apr 11 09:00–16:00. Rooms: Q3 reserved 08:30–13:00. Backup Zoom link added.

alisha: Coordinator checklist (please follow):
```
- Arrive 08:15, meet candidate at main lobby (front desk has guest name + hotel)
- Hand badge and escort to Quiet Room Q3
- Offer bottled water/coffee (dairy-free snack labeled)
- Confirm loaner laptop pickup time with IT (Kelly)
- Give interpreter Zoom link if used; have phone contact for Sam
- Provide parking pass (if driving) or Lyft voucher (if using)
- After loop: collect short feedback forms, ensure recruiter (Sam) collects scorecards
```

ben: Got it — parking pass printed, Lyft voucher is ready to email. Catering ordered: fruit + GF/dairy-free bars.

kelly: Loaner will be available 08:25 at IT desk. I'll DM Arman for a time slot and confirm access. Temp account will expire in 72h.

mike: Can we surface a 1-page "warm-up" doc for the candidate so they know the loop focus? A few bullet prompts for system design + infra tradeoffs.

alisha: Yes — here's the quick doc link: https://docs.redwood/internals/hiring/warmup-ar-man (one-pager). Also adding this to the calendar invite.

sam: Interpreter booked remotely as backup (vendor: LinguaNow). Sam will confirm by EOD. Stipend: $150 travel reimbursement — I'll send the form.

kelly: FYI — if the loaner USB dongle is needed for VPN, bring it to the desk. I've attached a short creds note in a DM.

alisha: Final ask: can @ben be the day-of point of contact? If yes, I'll include Ben's cell and Alisha's cell in the confirmation email.

ben: Happy to be POC. Cell: +1-415-555-0187.

sam: I'll send candidate confirmation now with arrival details, POC, parking instructions, dietary notes, and backup Zoom. Will copy the team. :thumbsup:

mike: Thanks all. Please react to confirm you received checklist. :white_check_mark:
